_doc: Fields a client sends WITHOUT end-to-end encryption, per entity kind. Every other field value is encrypted. Only values the server must read stay plaintext: fan-out and membership checks (project_id, task_id, assignee_id, actor_id) and attachment blob addressing (blob_sha, thumb_sha); wrapped_key and meta are already ciphertext. project_member rows are server-authored. The client (packages/client-core) encrypts by this table and the server (crates/atlas-server) asserts that every field value it reads is listed here.
